welcome_01.text: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen, and welcome once again to Mildew!

wrong_01.text: No. I'm afraid that's completely wrong.

mystified_01.text: I don't know how you knew that.

takes_lead_01.text: And that puts you into the lead!

off_air_warning_01.text: I told you not to do that.

closing_01.text: Ladies and gentlemen, that is all we have time for tonight.

qwen.g.lobby_empty.1.text: Good evening. We appear to have no contestants.

qwen.g.lobby_empty.3.text: Take your time. We've only got the one studio.

qwen.g.lobby_empty.4.text: I've done this programme in front of fewer people. Not many fewer.

qwen.g.lobby_empty.5.text: Phones out, please. The little code on the side of the screen. Yes, that one.

qwen.g.lobby_one.1.text: One is not really a party.

qwen.g.lobby_ready.1.text: That's enough of you. Whenever you're ready.

qwen.g.lobby_ready.3.text: Somebody press the button. Not me. I'm not allowed.

qwen.g.reserved_name.2.text: There's only one Graham on this programme.

qwen.g.show_open.1.text: Good evening, and welcome to Mildew. I'm Graham Mildew.

qwen.g.show_open.2.text: Hello, good evening, and welcome to Mildew.

qwen.g.show_open_2.1.text: Tonight's contestants are all here voluntarily. Mostly.

qwen.g.rehearsal_intro.1.text: Before we start properly, a quick studio rehearsal. The points are real.

qwen.g.rehearsal_intro.2.text: The floor manager wants a rehearsal. So. Some questions. Points count.

qwen.g.question_read.3.text: Next question. This one's easy. Allegedly.

qwen.g.all_correct.2.text: Everybody got that. We'll make the next one harder.

qwen.g.some_correct.1.text: Well done to those who got it.

qwen.g.some_correct.2.text: Some of you got that. Some of you didn't.

qwen.g.nobody_answered.1.text: Nobody answered. We'll call that a technical fault.

qwen.g.tie.1.text: A tie. How disappointing for everyone.

qwen.g.sign_off.1.text: That's the rehearsal. The real programme will be along shortly. Goodnight.

qwen.g.sign_off.2.text: That's all we have time for. Goodnight. Mind how you go.

qwen.g.reconnect_mid.3.text: We'll wait. We're very good at waiting.

qwen.g.waiting_players.1.text: We need at least two of you. That's how contests work.

qwen.g.waiting_players.2.text: We'll wait for somebody else. Anybody.

qwen.g.rom_intro.1.text: Next. Real or Mildew. Some of what you're about to read is true. That's the frightening part.

qwen.g.rom_intro.2.text: It's time for Real or Mildew. The truth, and things we made up. Like a newspaper.

qwen.g.rom_intro.3.text: Real or Mildew. Every fact in this round was checked by a team of professionals. One of them is lying.

qwen.g.rom_rules.1.text: Four claims. Find the real one — or, if I tell you three are real, find the one we invented. Choose on your device.

qwen.g.rom_rules.2.text: Read carefully. Some rounds, one is real. Some rounds, one is Mildew. Listen to which round it is. Then panic.

qwen.g.rom_rules.3.text: Find what I ask for. The real one, or the fake. They're all written by the same man. He's very convincing.

qwen.g.rom_ask.2.text: Take your time. Not too much.

qwen.g.rom_ask.5.text: Read them all. Slowly. Moving your lips is fine.

qwen.g.rom_certain_intro.1.text: This one's special. If you're certain, tell us. Certain and right, double points. Certain and wrong, I'll remember.

qwen.g.rom_certain_intro.2.text: Confidence round. Press I'M CERTAIN if you are. We'll see.

qwen.g.rom_final.1.text: Last one. Worth more. Concentrate. Everybody. Even you at the back.

qwen.g.rom_final.2.text: Final question in this round. It's a big one.

qwen.g.rom_outro.1.text: That's Real or Mildew. If you learnt anything, keep it to yourselves.

qwen.g.rom_outro.2.text: And that's the end of Real or Mildew. The facts are on our Viewer Information Service, if you can be bothered.

qwen.g.gtg_intro.1.text: It's time. Guess the Genitals. This is respectable television, and I'll thank you to treat it that way.

qwen.g.gtg_intro.2.text: Ladies and gentlemen, Guess the Genitals. Biology, at its most honest.

qwen.g.gtg_intro.3.text: Guess the Genitals. I've done this round for years. You never get used to it. You just stop flinching.

qwen.g.gtg_rules.1.text: You'll see a reproductive organ. Animal only — we do have standards. Tell us whose it is.

qwen.g.gtg_rules.2.text: A specimen will appear. Identify the animal. No touching the screen.

qwen.g.gtg_rules.3.text: Each picture belongs to an animal. Mostly. Pick the owner. The faster you are, the more questions it raises.

qwen.g.gtg_final.1.text: The final genital. Worth more points, and frankly worth more of your attention.

qwen.g.gtg_final.2.text: And now: the final genital. Brace yourselves. Clinically.

qwen.g.gtg_outro.1.text: That's Guess the Genitals. Wash your eyes. Or don't. It's a free country.

qwen.g.gtg_outro.2.text: And that concludes Guess the Genitals. Thank you to all the animals involved. None of them consented.

qwen.g.sv_intro.1.text: It's the Mildew Survey. We asked the public. The public were unavailable, so we're asking you.

qwen.g.sv_intro.2.text: Time for the Mildew Survey. Your answers are anonymous. Your shame is not.

qwen.g.sv_intro.3.text: The Mildew Survey. Write what you think. Then judge each other. It's very healthy.

qwen.g.sv_rules.1.text: I'll ask a question. Type an answer on your device. Then vote for the best one. Not your own. We check.

qwen.g.sv_rules.2.text: Write an answer. Vote for somebody else's. Some answers come from our archive. Some of the archive is very old.

qwen.g.sv_ask.2.text: Thumbs ready. Here's what the survey wants to know.

qwen.g.sv_ask.3.text: This one came in by post. Unsigned.

qwen.g.sv_ask.4.text: Our researchers asked this question four hundred times. Your turn.

qwen.g.sv_no_votes.1.text: Nobody voted. A survey of silence.

qwen.g.sv_no_votes.2.text: Not a single vote. Apathy. Very British.

qwen.g.sv_archive_reveal.1.text: That one came from the archive. Nobody remembers who wrote it.

qwen.g.sv_archive_reveal.2.text: The archive answer. Some of those are from 1998. Some of them aren't.

qwen.g.sv_archive_reveal.3.text: That was from our archive. Don't ask whose.

qwen.g.sv_outro.1.text: That concludes the survey. Results will be shared with nobody.

qwen.g.sv_outro.2.text: The Mildew Survey. Thank you for your honesty. Some of you should see someone.

qwen.g.mf_intro.1.text: It's Mouthfeel. The round where you describe things that should never be in your mouth.

qwen.g.mf_intro.2.text: Welcome to Mouthfeel. Use your words. Your awful, awful words.

qwen.g.mf_intro.3.text: Mouthfeel. I've done this round for years. I still can't eat soup.

qwen.g.mf_rules.1.text: I'll name something. You describe how it feels in your mouth. Then everybody votes for the category I give you. I may enter an answer myself. Anonymously.

qwen.g.mf_rules.2.text: Describe the mouthfeel. Vote on the category. Don't vote for yourself. I'll know.

qwen.g.mf_ask.2.text: Close your eyes. Open your mouth. Not literally.

qwen.g.mf_ask.4.text: Here it is. Take your time. Chew it over.

qwen.g.mf_no_votes.1.text: No votes. You've all lost your appetite.

qwen.g.mf_chain_final.1.text: And there it is. Rate it. Be honest.

qwen.g.mf_chain_final.2.text: Look what you've made. Rate it on your devices.

qwen.g.mf_chain_final.3.text: That's what you've built. Someone has to eat it. Rate it.

qwen.g.mf_chain_good.1.text: A masterpiece. Points shared between the chefs.

qwen.g.mf_chain_good.2.text: That's genuinely horrible. Well done, all of you.

qwen.g.mf_chain_bad.1.text: Not your best work. Not anybody's best work.

qwen.g.mf_chain_bad.2.text: Underwhelming. Even the bin doesn't want it.

qwen.g.mf_outro.1.text: That's Mouthfeel. Have a glass of water. Have several.

qwen.g.mf_outro.2.text: That concludes Mouthfeel. Please do not eat any of it at home.

qwen.g.mf_rev_ask.1.text: I'm going to describe something. You tell me what it is.

qwen.g.mf_rev_ask.2.text: Here's my tasting note. What am I eating?

qwen.g.mf_rev_ask.3.text: Listen carefully. What am I describing?

qwen.g.mf_rev_final.1.text: Last one. Concentrate. What is in my mouth?

qwen.g.wv_discarded.1.text: One answer has been removed. No. We're not putting that on television.

qwen.g.wv_discarded.2.text: We've taken one out. You know who you are.

qwen.g.wv_altered.2.text: I've corrected one of those. You're welcome.

qwen.g.wv_graham_won.3.text: That one was me. Thirty years in the business.

qwen.g.wv_archive_won.1.text: You voted for the archive. Somebody wrote that a long time ago. They'd be pleased. Probably.

qwen.g.wv_archive_won.2.text: The archive wins. It usually does.

qwen.g.wv_match.1.text: Two of you wrote the same thing. That's either telepathy or a worrying sign. Bonus points.

qwen.g.wv_match.2.text: A match! Same answer, independently. Bonus.

qwen.g.ps_intro.1.text: Police Sketch. A crime has been committed against good taste. You are the witnesses.

qwen.g.ps_intro.2.text: It's Police Sketch. Draw what the witness describes. The witness is unreliable. So are you.

qwen.g.ps_rules.1.text: Draw what you're told. The next person describes your drawing. The next draws that. We'll see what survives.

qwen.g.ps_rules.2.text: Each of you starts a case. It passes along the line: drawing, description, drawing. Then we compare it with the truth.

qwen.g.ps_rules_two.1.text: Two of you. One draws, the other says what it is. Then swap. Nowhere to hide.

qwen.g.ps_rules_two.2.text: You draw one. They guess it. Then the other way round. Simple police work.

qwen.g.ps_draw_open.2.text: Draw it. Quickly. The suspect is getting away.

qwen.g.ps_describe_open.1.text: Now. Look at what somebody's drawn, and tell me what it is. Kindly.

qwen.g.ps_describe_open.2.text: Describe the drawing. The artist is in the room. Be honest anyway.

qwen.g.ps_comment.5.text: Our forensic team have asked for a moment.

qwen.g.ps_mutated.1.text: That's not what we started with.

qwen.g.ps_mutated.2.text: Somewhere along the line, that became a different crime.

qwen.g.ps_mutated.3.text: And that's how innocent people go to prison.

qwen.g.ps_faithful.1.text: They got it. Remarkable police work.

qwen.g.ps_vote_funny.1.text: Vote for the funniest mutation. Not your own case.

qwen.g.ps_vote_funny.2.text: Which case went most wrong? Vote.

qwen.g.ps_vote_drawing.1.text: And the best drawing. 'Best' is doing a lot of work there.

qwen.g.ps_vote_drawing.2.text: Now vote for the best drawing. Use the word loosely.

qwen.g.ps_outro.1.text: That concludes Police Sketch. All drawings will be kept on file.

qwen.g.ps_outro.2.text: Police Sketch. Case closed. Several cases, actually, badly.

qwen.g.ps_exhibit.1.text: Before we start. An exhibit from a previous interview. We never found him.

qwen.g.ps_exhibit.2.text: This drawing was handed in by a previous contestant. We still don't know what it is.

qwen.g.dnp_intro.1.text: Do Not Press That. A test of teamwork, communication, and restraint. You'll fail at least one.

qwen.g.dnp_intro.2.text: It's Do Not Press That. Everyone has buttons. Everyone has instructions. Nobody has both. Talk to each other.

qwen.g.dnp_rules.1.text: Your device shows your controls and your instructions. Your instructions are about somebody else's controls. Talk. Out loud. Like people.

qwen.g.dnp_rules.2.text: Read your instructions out. Operate your own controls. And there's always one thing you should not press.

qwen.g.dnp_puzzle_intro.3.text: Production have asked me to read this out. Quickly.

qwen.g.dnp_perfect.1.text: Perfect. Not a single mistake. I'm almost disappointed.

qwen.g.dnp_completed.2.text: Completed. The studio thanks you. The studio is still on fire, but thanks you.

qwen.g.dnp_barely.2.text: Just about. I wouldn't put that on your CV.

qwen.g.dnp_failed.2.text: That's a failure. Someone will have to tell Neil.

qwen.g.dnp_failed.3.text: Out of time. That's going to leave a mark.

qwen.g.dnp_outro.1.text: That's Do Not Press That. Most of you pressed it.

qwen.g.dnp_outro.2.text: Do Not Press That. Thank you. Please wash your hands.

qwen.g.bas_intro.1.text: The Basement. Something has happened. You weren't there. Neither was I. Officially.

qwen.g.bas_intro.2.text: Time for The Basement. Our investigative strand. We've never solved anything, but we keep trying.

qwen.g.bas_rules.1.text: Each of you has evidence on your device. Some of it matters. Some of it doesn't. Talk it through, then each of you files your own theory.

qwen.g.bas_rules.2.text: You may investigate. Not much. We have a budget. Share what you like. Or don't. I'll be watching your faces.

qwen.g.bas_setup.2.text: This was reported to us this week.

qwen.g.bas_setup.3.text: Read it. Then look at your evidence. Then talk.

qwen.g.bas_theory.1.text: Time's up. File your theories. On your own. No conferring now.

qwen.g.bas_theory.2.text: Enough talk. What do you each think happened?

qwen.g.bas_group_agreed.1.text: You all agree. That's either very good police work or a very loud person.

qwen.g.bas_group_agreed.2.text: Unanimous. Let's see if you're unanimously wrong.

qwen.g.bas_group_split.1.text: You don't agree. Interesting. Somebody's been quiet.

qwen.g.bas_group_split.2.text: A split jury. Let's find out who was listening.

qwen.g.bas_unresolved.1.text: We never found out. We stopped asking.

qwen.g.bas_unresolved.2.text: And that's as far as anyone got.

qwen.g.bas_outro.1.text: That's The Basement. Please don't go down there.

qwen.g.poll_intro.1.text: Viewer poll. We asked you at home. Now we're asking you, at home.

qwen.g.poll_intro.2.text: Time for the viewer poll. There are no wrong answers. There are some very wrong answers.

qwen.g.poll_result.1.text: The nation has spoken. The nation is wrong.

qwen.g.poll_result.3.text: That's what you think. Noted. On file.

qwen.g.awards_intro.1.text: Before we go, the Mildew awards. Handed out by me, on merit and on mood.

qwen.g.awards_intro.2.text: Awards. Some of you deserve them. Some of you are getting them anyway.

qwen.g.part_two.1.text: Welcome back. Part two. Nothing happened during the break.

qwen.g.part_two.2.text: We're back. Sit down. Somebody's still in the kitchen.

qwen.g.hole_intro.1.text: Our first game tonight. It's called Hole. I didn't name it.

qwen.g.hole_intro.2.text: Time for Hole. A simple game. Some of you will still struggle.

qwen.g.hole_intro.3.text: Hole. The game where we show you an opening and you tell us what it belongs to.

qwen.g.hole_rules.1.text: We start very close. Lock in early and it's worth fifteen hundred. Wait, and it's worth less. Once you've locked, you've locked.

qwen.g.hole_rules.2.text: The closer the look when you lock in, the more it's worth. Fifteen hundred at first glance, five hundred if you need it spelled out.

qwen.g.hole_rules.3.text: Lock in on your unit whenever you're sure. You can't change your mind. This isn't a democracy.

qwen.g.hole_last_look.1.text: Last look. Lock in now or forever hold your peace.

qwen.g.hole_last_look.2.text: That's as much as you're getting.

qwen.g.hole_safety_net.1.text: For those still dithering, multiple choice. Five hundred points.

qwen.g.hole_safety_net.2.text: Here are some options, for the cowards.

qwen.g.hole_safety_net.3.text: Multiple choice. No shame in it. Some shame in it.

qwen.g.hole_nobody_right.3.text: Not a single correct answer. We'll edit that out.

qwen.g.hole_nobody_locked.1.text: Nobody locked in. Nobody. It's not a spectator sport.

qwen.g.hole_nobody_locked.2.text: Not one answer. I've seen more participation at a funeral.

qwen.g.hole_all_correct.1.text: All of you. Everybody knows what that is. Says a lot.

qwen.g.hole_all_correct.2.text: Full marks all round. Don't get used to it.

qwen.g.hole_scale_intro.1.text: This one's a scale round. Not what it is. How big it is.

qwen.g.hole_scale_intro.2.text: Something different. Tell me how big this hole is.

qwen.g.hole_open_intro.1.text: No multiple choice this time. You either know your holes or you don't.

qwen.g.hole_open_intro.2.text: Advanced round. No safety net. Grown-ups only.

qwen.g.hole_outro.1.text: That was Hole. Some of you should be very proud. One of you should be watched.

qwen.g.hole_outro.2.text: And that's the end of Hole. I'll never look at a crumpet the same way.

qwen.g.hole_outro.3.text: That's Hole. Thank you. Wash your hands.

qwen.g.incident_mic_pop.3.text: That was the microphone. Not me.

qwen.g.incident_early_applause.2.text: Hold your applause. Hold it. Thank you.

qwen.g.incident_reset.1.text: Let's have a lovely, normal bit of telly.

qwen.g.test_after.2.text: Apologies for the interruption. That wasn't for you.
